text:
Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and go to the beach. One day, Timmy's mom told him they were going to the beach. While they were playing, Timmy saw a little bird and wanted to catch it. He was scared that the bird could not get it back.

Timmy asked his mom, "Can I make my toy car very high?" His mom replied, "Yes, but you have to be careful." Timmy was so excited to play with the car and it started to fill up with air.

Timmy's mom told him, "It's okay, Timmy. You can put it back where you found it. It's very useful." Timmy was happy to hear that and they continued to run around the blue house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play at the park with her friends. One day, Lily saw a squirrel with a big tree. She told the squirrel that the squirrel was not a good friend. Her friends agreed and they worked together to get the squirrel. 

After the squirrel was safe, Lily picked up the squirrel and showed it to her friends. They all agreed to use it to make a new friend. They were happy to see the squirrel again with their new friends.
